nodes.label: Platizio Services LLP
nodes.rationale: Financial Products Distribution Platform; positioning 'Navigate every market with confidence'. Licensed/certified distributor of Mutual Funds and SIFs; AMFI ARN 341407; LLPIN AAQ-9558 (incorporated 5 Dec 2019); operates under SEBI framework; explicitly not a broker, adviser, portfolio manager, or research analyst.

nodes.label: Specialised Investment Funds (SIF)
nodes.rationale: SEBI-regulated vehicle with long-short, derivatives, and dynamic asset allocation in a mutual-fund-like framework; Equity/Debt/Hybrid strategy types; aimed at informed investors. SEBI SIF framework dated 27 February 2025. Use 'Specialised' spelling consistently.

nodes.label: Mutual Funds
nodes.rationale: Professionally managed pooled diversified portfolios; categories: Equity, Hybrid, Debt, Consumption-Focused, Thematic, Sectoral. Mandatory disclaimer: 'Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks...'

nodes.label: Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
nodes.rationale: Direct-ownership personalized portfolios for HNIs under SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020; SEBI-prescribed minimum investment Rs 50 lakh; discretionary vs non-discretionary formats.

nodes.label: Alternative Investment Funds (AIF)
nodes.rationale: SEBI-regulated pooled vehicles beyond conventional equity/debt (private equity, VC, structured credit, long-short) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012; Categories I/II/III; Rs 1 crore minimum; liquidity trade-off with lock-ins.

nodes.label: International Investing
nodes.rationale: Global diversification outside India (US, Europe, China, emerging markets); currency risk is evaluated within overall portfolio risk; process: market selection, risk/allocation assessment, integration, periodic review.

nodes.label: AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India)
SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)
Platizio Global (Global-Investing Service Layer)
nodes.rationale: Service/distribution/technology layer for eligible international products (U.S.-listed stocks, ETFs, fractional shares); Platizio does not execute orders, hold client funds, or custody securities; user is responsible for LRS/FEMA limits, tax and foreign-asset reporting.

nodes.label: ViewTrade (Execution Partner)
nodes.rationale: Handles order execution, settlement, and statements for Platizio Global international products.

nodes.label: Anuj Pal (Grievance Officer / Senior Financial Market Analyst)
nodes.rationale: Named as Operations and Compliance Officer/Head and Grievance Officer (grievances@platizio.com, +91 9289837100); also listed in the team as Senior Financial Market Analyst; grievances acknowledged within 24 hours, resolved within 15 business/working days.

nodes.label: Book a Consultation Form
nodes.rationale: Fields: Full Name, Email, Phone (required); Product of Interest, Message (optional); submit label 'Submit Request'. Legacy Formspree endpoint is a placeholder — a real server action/CRM endpoint and privacy-consent review are needed. Calendar integration was 'coming soon' only.

nodes.label: Legal Pages (Privacy Policies + Terms)
nodes.rationale: Master privacy policy (DPDP Act, retention: KYC/AML >=8y, transactions >=10y, communications 5y, cookies <=24mo), master terms (Delhi law, Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996), plus separate global-investing privacy/terms. Legal wording must be carried across verbatim from the legacy source and reviewed by counsel before publishing.
